create_schedule.name: create_schedule
create_schedule.description: Create a Schedule in the user's Orialis calendar. One event per activity in each date/time slot, including separate activities on the same day. Before writing, split the source into individual occurrences with their own title, startAt, endAt and location. For example, morning West Lake photography, noon campus visit, outbound train and return train are separate events. Never create a trip-summary event spanning the first departure to the final return, or hide other dates/time slots in description. Description may contain only details for that event. A single continuous overnight train or other continuous activity may cross midnight. Missing times must be clarified or left pending, never invented or replaced by a multi-day/all-day placeholder. After writing, read back every saved event and report each title and time separately; do not report a summary event as successful splitting.

title.description: One activity in one date/time slot; never a whole trip or daily agenda.

description.description: Notes for this activity only. Multiple dated or timed agenda entries are rejected with split_required.

startAt.description: Start of this activity with timezone; never the start of the whole itinerary.

endAt.description: End of this activity with timezone; never the final return of the whole itinerary.
